method: The first five two-column cases in the fixed 60-case schedule were used for development and the last five were held out. The source ID split was frozen before inspecting the first tuning appeal. Every native and forced-OCR run used identical generated bytes across revisions. Only tuning examples informed implementation. The ten cases share a generator. Private results contain aggregate metrics only.
paired_dev_method: The current main, column-order-only and final pipelines consumed the same first PDF/OCR observation for each document. Each constructed its own transcript, party inventory and downstream extraction arguments. A downstream value was reused only for identical extraction inputs; differing inputs were extracted independently. Each raw JSON and sibling repair reading was compared before scoring the batch. A public two-column tuning appeal produced different outputs with this harness, while a public single-column appeal matched.
